capabilities: Transfer the current note to another vault and link back to it
Transfer multiple notes or a folder into a matching target folder
Insert a link to a note in another vault without transferring content
Pick a target vault from a configured root of vaults
Configure overwrite behavior, link creation, and deletion of the original
extras: Desktop only; transfers must be triggered from a Markdown file, and the target vault path must be re-entered when vault locations differ across devices.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to move a note from one vault to another while keeping a link to it in the original vault.
summary: Vault-to-vault transfer tool that moves a note, or a whole folder, to another vault and links back to the original note.
